hooks.command: FILE_PATH=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$FILE_PATH" in *.rs) ~/.cargo/bin/cargo fmt --manifest-path "$(dirname "$FILE_PATH")/../Cargo.toml" 2>/dev/null || ~/.cargo/bin/cargo fmt 2>/dev/null || true ;; esac
FILE_PATH=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$FILE_PATH" in */lsp/src/*.rs) ~/.cargo/bin/cargo clippy -p todo-highlight-lsp -- -D warnings 2>&1 | head -40 ;; esac
